fire: The new ruler jailed every officer suspected of ties to the old regime.

She fired staff she regarded as having betrayed her.
Anyone suspected of disloyalty was sent to the camps.
He took revenge on those he believed had insulted him.
quiet: The new ruler met every officer in the hall of the old palace.
There were visits by all the new teachers in the province.
He used his office to welcome anyone who came with a question.
Soldiers helped villagers rebuild the school after the storm.
The local police gave out maps of the town to tourists.
She thanked staff who had stayed late to help her.
Anyone interested in chess was sent an invitation.
He sent flowers to those who had visited him.
